summary: BRP Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing results of its annual shareholders' meeting held May 28, 2026. The report covers director elections (all 12 nominees elected with strong support), reappointment of auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (99.85% in favor), and adoption of the advisory say-on-pay resolution (99.32% in favor). No special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine meeting results filing. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. No action is required from the filer beyond disclosure.
